notes.title: SVN1081 release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42463733/1f510c6b07cc95c4c0875e077b7bc9ffab750a9a.png[/img]

After a year of effort, this fully enhanced version is finally available to everyone.
 
In this version, in addition to the comprehensive enhancement of sound and visual effects, we have replaced the old, simplistic resource gathering system with a new industry chain system. We have also introduced richer diplomatic elements, more victory modes, and more types of buildings.To celebrate the release of this version and apologize for the long period of no updates, we have decided to launch a promotional campaign.
 
As for the specific details of these hundreds of updates, we won't list them here one by one. I believe that reading these contents is also very boring. Anyway, I wish you all have a good time.

notes.title: Update Notes For 01/03/2023
notes.content:
1) Redesign art resources such as the leaders' portraits and the commanders' portraits.
2) Add a consultant system which gives suggestions to the player. We will continuely improve this function with the update in the future.
3) Modify the operation rules of the manual battle system and replace the previous formation system with the special order system.
4) Now you can choose to attack a single warship in the enemy team or the entire team.
5) You can now deploy buildings directly from the fleet.
6) Now you can create or edit fleets without a dock.
7) Colonial income was changed from daily to monthly.

notes.title: 21/11/2022 Readjusted battlefield operations, the music, and the arts.
notes.content:
1) Readjusted battlefield operations. Box selection no longer requires pressing the CTRL key.
2) Battlefields can now be resized with the mouse wheel.
3) Adjusted the music & sound effects.
4) Adjusted the arts.

1) The construction method of space building facilities has been changed. It was changed from direct construction in the former colony to factory construction, and can be towed by the fleet.

2) Increase settlements and commodity production. Now you can build settlements and use the explored settlement warehouse to upgrade the settlements. The new settlements can produce all kinds of goods for trade.

3) The new Trade Center space station is used to sell or resell goods.

4)Add pirates. Colonies with weak defenses have a certain probability of being attacked by pirates.

5)Trim some music sound effects.


[b]This update may cause damage to the old archive. It is recommended that you start with a new game.[/b]
